title: Jesus Anointed in Bethany
description: In Bethany, a woman anoints Jesus with expensive nard oil. According to Matthew and Mark, she anoints his head in the house of Simon the Leper, while according to John, Mary anoints his feet. The disciples react against what they see as waste, but Jesus defends her, saying she has prepared him for burial.

versions.title: Jesus Anointed in Bethany
versions.description: A woman anoints Jesus' head with expensive oil in Bethany as a preparation for his burial.
versions.reason: [minor] description: The description mentions only the anointing of the head, but in John's version the feet are anointed. It could be expanded to cover both.
